answer: One birth certificate binds each identity: the civil registry signs its hash into the Vine Registry, with a 30 POA bond locked 90 days. Each extra record from one funding cluster doubles the bond, 30, 60, 120, 240, capped at 960 POA, so 100 fakes lock 92,130 POA, plus 8,000 POA in broker fees. Each epoch a fresh signal demands re-attestation within 72 hours; two misses forfeit half the bond and freeze payouts 3 epochs. Duplicate records slash both bonds. The audit thread is public: any verifier replays every hash and fee. Twins pass a joint check; adoptees use a court-sealed record.
